title: Employee Attendance Policy
description: All employees must arrive on time and follow their assigned work schedule.

title: Guest Service Policy
description: Employees must treat all guests with respect and provide professional and friendly service.

title: Uniform Policy
description: Employees must wear the approved hotel uniform during working hours and maintain a professional appearance.

title: Health and Safety Policy
description: All employees must follow company health and safety procedures and report any hazards immediately.

title: Leave Policy
description: Employees must submit leave requests in advance and receive approval from the responsible manager.

title: Guest Privacy Policy
description: Employees must protect guest information and must not share personal or confidential guest details.

title: Employee Conduct Policy
description: Employees are expected to behave professionally and respectfully toward guests, colleagues, and management.

title: Emergency Procedures Policy
description: Employees must follow company emergency procedures and assist guests according to their assigned responsibilities.
